en: Humorous Dutch postcard showing a black-and-white dog against a blue background. The dog is behind a circular sign-style design encircled by orange gladiolus flowers and holding a medal ribbon in its mouth. The center of the sign reads "Nijmegen 30 km 4 daagse." Above the dog, curved text says "Op m'n sloffen !!!". At the bottom are a pair of cartoonish slippers shaped like little characters.
